---
title: "Options"
engine: pari-gp
---

## Cell options

Written as `#|` comments at the top of a cell.

| Option | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `eval` | `true` | Run the cell. `false` shows the code without running it. |
| `echo` | `true` | Show the source. |
| `output` | `true` | Show what gp printed. `asis` inserts it as raw markdown. |
| `error` | `false` | `true` renders gp errors into the document; `false` stops the render. |
| `include` | `true` | `false` drops the cell from the output entirely — it still runs. |
| `classes` | — | Extra CSS classes for the code block. |
| `filename` | — | Filename label above the code block. |
| `label` | — | Cell label; `fig-…` makes a figure cross-referenceable. |
| `fig-cap` | — | Figure caption. |
| `fig-alt` | — | Accessible description of a figure. |
| `fig-width` | — | CSS width for an inline SVG figure. |

### `echo: false`

Run it, show only the result:

```{gp}
#| echo: false
print("The code that produced this line is hidden.")
```

### `eval: false`

Show it without running it — useful for code that is slow or needs data you do
not ship:

```{gp}
#| eval: false
\\ This never runs.
forprime(p = 2, 10^12, if (p % 4 == 1, print(p)))
```

### `output: asis`

The output is inserted as markdown rather than wrapped in a code block, so gp
can generate document structure:

```{gp}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
for (n = 3, 5, printf("- %d! = %d\n", n, n!))
```

### `include: false`

The cell runs — so later cells can use what it defines — but nothing appears:

```{gp}
#| include: false
secret = 1729;
```

```{gp}
secret
```

## Document options

Everything under `pari-gp:` in the front matter, all optional:

```yaml
---
engine: pari-gp
pari-gp:
  path: gp              # gp executable, if it is not on PATH
  args: []              # extra arguments passed to gp
  stacksize: 32M        # parisize
  primelimit: 500000    # primelimit
  precision: 50         # realprecision, in decimal digits
  bitprecision: 128     # realbitprecision (alternative to precision)
  seriesprecision: 16   # seriesprecision
  timeout: 300          # seconds before the render gives up
  highlight: true       # inject the syntax definition automatically
  prelude: |            # gp code run once, before the first cell
    default(output, 0);
    read("mylib.gp");
  echo: true            # defaults for every cell in the document
  output: true
  error: false
---
```

`echo`, `output`, `error`, `eval` and `include` set the default for every cell;
a cell option overrides it.

### `prelude`

Useful for loading a library of your own, or changing how gp formats results.
This page sets nothing, so matrices print in gp's usual style:

```{gp}
factor(360)
```

## Errors

By default a PARI/GP error stops the render, naming the cell and the message.
When the error is the point, ask for it:

```{gp}
#| error: true
1/0
```

The session survives either way — gp keeps reading, so later cells still run:

```{gp}
6 * 7
```

gp's `*** Warning:` lines are warnings, not errors: they are shown, but never
stop a render.
